training_rounding: nearest integer nanosecond, exact half ties earlier; floor/ceiling enclosure retained separately, not fit covariance
validation_rounding: earliest floor, latest ceiling; no inward rounding or midpoint replacement
ordering: complete explicit inventory in ascending (offset_ns, skew_ppb) order
partial_results: resource, cancellation, mapping or policy refusal returns no successful prefix
numerical_refusals: unresolved, including rounding-induced observation collisions; never evidence of impossible clocks
report_digest: SHA-256 of exact compact report object UTF-8, without outer response or newline
source_claim: input bytes hash-checked; source, camera, world and association pins remain caller assertions
qualification: validation rows participate in clock search, not independent qualification of a selected clock
authority: no clock activation, continuous-rate certification, authenticated custody, physical calibration, coverage or effects
compatibility: original offset query and response formats unchanged; drift requires its own explicit schema
validation_status: native contracts added but unexecuted here; independent exact-rational mapping, numerical fixture, deterministic byte reproduction and schema checks executed
